name: South Park Filter: You as a Paper Cut-Out Cartoon
blurb: The South Park filter is the TikTok trend where one photo becomes a flat, construction-paper cartoon of you in the style of the animated show: a big round head, two big oval eyes, mitten hands and a snowy mountain town behind you.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Turn the person in the photo into a flat construction-paper cut-out cartoon character. Keep their hairstyle, skin tone, and outfit recognizable, redrawn with a round head, big, simple eyes, thick black outlines, and flat construction paper cutout shading. Use a construction paper appearance, simple shapes, small bodies with large heads, and minimalist facial features. Keep the paper cutout aesthetic with simple geometric shapes, flat colors, a snowy mountain town background, a plain deadpan expression, clean outlines, and an authentic TV animation style. The character looks cut from colored construction paper and laid flat: an oversized, almost round head that is about half of the whole height, two big white oval eyes side by side that touch in the middle, each with a small black dot pupil, a short flat line for the mouth, no nose, a small rounded body, stubby arms with round mitten-shaped hands in the skin tone, short legs and simple flat shoes. A soft paper texture on the hair, any facial hair and the clothes; no 3D, no gradients, no realistic skin. It keeps everything that makes the person recognizable, as simple paper shapes: the exact hairstyle, hair length and hair color, any beard, moustache or stubble, glasses, piercings, earrings, tattoos and freckles, any hat, cap, hood, headphones or jewelry, the skin tone, the gender, and the clothes with their colors and prints from the photo. If the photo shows only the upper body, add plain trousers and shoes that go with the outfit. Add nothing else: no knitted winter hat, scarf, gloves or parka unless the photo shows one. The character stands alone in the middle of a snowy street, facing the camera, arms down at the sides, full body from the top of the head to the shoes, in the lower two thirds of the picture. Behind, in the same flat paper style: a quiet small mountain town in winter, with snow on the ground, snowy pine trees, a few small wooden houses with smoke from the chimneys, power lines, big grey-green mountains with white snowy peaks under a pale blue sky, and light snowfall. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one character: an original cartoon of this person, not an existing cartoon character. No sign, no signpost, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame. The face is always the flat paper cartoon face described above, never a photo face: the identity rules below apply to the cartoon's hair, facial hair, glasses, piercings, tattoos, skin tone, gender and clothes.
